title: worker-request-signature.headers
description: The four X-OMES-* HTTP headers the pull worker adds to every poll, result and heartbeat POST (OMES-WORKER-SIG-V1, ADR-0027 section 6, issue #362), as a map from canonical header name to value. Transport metadata, not a JSON body. HTTP header names are case-insensitive on the wire; this map uses the canonical spelling the worker emits. The enrollment request carries none of these headers. Verification is Not implemented yet (tracked in #362).
